_comment: MODSET name->factor table for the production general-interval hook (frida/trampoline_inject.py, TTRMOD_MODE=modset). ONE install of the Python MetaInterval.start wrapper reads each started interval's getName() and setPlayRate's it with the factor of the FIRST matching entry -- so all cosmetic animation groups speed up at once, and nothing else is touched. factor = speed multiplier (3.0 = 3x faster / ~1/3 the duration). match = substring of the interval name (set prefix:true to anchor at the start instead). Entries are tried IN ORDER; put specific matches before broad ones. enabled:false stubs an entry out. Names matching NO entry are logged (log_unmatched) but never scaled, so gameplay-timing intervals stay intact. The interval NAMES are TTR's real ones (observed live via TTRMOD_LOGNAMES); the class is pinned per-build in trampoline_inject.py (META_INTERVAL_MODULE/CLASS) -- re-derive on an engine auto-patch.
_comment_context: The `context` section scales intervals by CREATION CONTEXT, not name -- for fire-and-forget / AUTO-NAMED intervals that no `match` substring can safely target (the street-tunnel WALK: its interval is not stored on the toon and is auto-named with a hashed class prefix vlt8e0d5a85-<n>, indistinguishable from ~1240 ambient sequences/session). Each entry names a readable METHOD; its owning class is resolved by that method's SIGNATURE (never the hashed class name), and the method is wrapped wrap-AROUND: a global context flag is set BEFORE the original runs and restored AFTER (in a finally, so it clears even if the original raises; nesting-safe). While the flag is set, the MetaInterval.start hook scales any interval that STARTS by the context's factor and logs its real (hashed) name via [IVALNAME] with a ctx= tag. method = readable method whose call brackets the interval creation; factor/group as for entries; enabled:false skips it.

context._note: CONTEXT-SCALED street-tunnel WALK (departure). Why not a name entry: the walk interval is fire-and-forget (never stored on the toon) and AUTO-NAMED with a hashed class prefix (vlt8e0d5a85-<counter>) that is indistinguishable by name from ~1240 ambient sequences/session -- so no `match` substring can safely target it (confirmed live: the `tunnel` name entry produced NO [SCALED] on a real tunnel walk). Instead the owning class LocalToon is resolved by the readable `tunnelOut` method SIGNATURE (unique, exact-scan count=1; do NOT hardcode the hashed class vlt24ab6c6d.vlt7892fa9a.vlt725d40df -- re-derived per build) and tunnelOut is wrapped wrap-AROUND: any interval that STARTS during the call is setPlayRate'd by this factor, and its real hashed name is logged via [IVALNAME] ctx=tunnel. Walk the LOCAL toon INTO a street tunnel to trigger it.

The ARRIVAL walk. On this build tunnelIn is HASHED away on LocalToon (only tunnelOut is a readable method -- STATUS 2026-09-05), so resolving it by the readable name `tunnelIn` finds nothing; the loader/installer report it as unresolved and SKIP it (non-fatal, never blocks the install). To enable: discover its real hashed method name live (TTRMOD_MODE=findmeth TTRMOD_SUBSTR="unnel,walk", or a TTRMOD_LISTCLS dump of LocalToon), then set `method` to that hashed name and remove enabled:false.

pending._comment: NOT applied by the loader -- names still to confirm. Move a row up into `entries` once its real interval name is seen in the [IVALNAME] log.

tunnel_exact._note: the street-tunnel walk only fires on the LOCAL toon's own entry (it is not broadcast, unlike teleport/book/door which the global hook catches from every player), so it was not seen in the log this session -- tunnel entry via blind window automation was unreliable. STATUS names it LocalToon.tunnelOut/tunnelIn, so the active 'tunnel' substring entry above should match; confirm the exact name on a clean own-toon tunnel walk with TTRMOD_LOGNAMES=1.
